Effective Date: 2nd January 2026

At SurveyPesa (survey-pesa.co.ke), we value your trust. This Privacy Policy explains how we collect, use, and protect your data when you use the best paid survey site in Kenya to earn cash for surveys.

1. Information We Collect

To provide you with legit online surveys, we collect specific information:

  • Personal Data: Your name, email address, and M-Pesa phone number to facilitate online surveys that pay through mobile money.
  • Demographic Data: Age, gender, location, and interests. This helps us match you with the right research surveys for money.
  • Technical Data: IP address and device type to prevent fake surveys and ensure account security.

2. How We Use Your Information

We use your data to:

  • Connect you with paid online survey jobs that fit your profile.
  • Process your cash money withdrawals via M-Pesa.
  • Notify you of new survey links to earn money and top survey sites opportunities.
  • Improve our platform to remain the highest paying survey website in the region.

3. Data Sharing and Third Parties

When you survey and earn, your responses are shared with market research partners. This data is usually anonymized. We never sell your M-Pesa number or private contact details to third-party advertisers. We only partner with paid surveys legit providers who respect international data protection standards.

4. Cookies and Tracking

We use cookies to keep you logged into your online survey job dashboard and to track your progress on payable online surveys. This ensures you are accurately paid for online surveys you complete.

5. Security of Your Data

We implement strict security measures to protect your survey earn balance and personal info. Whether you use our website or survey apps that pay, your connection is encrypted to prevent unauthorized access.

6. Your Rights

You have the right to:

  • Access or update your profile information.
  • Request the deletion of your account and data.
  • Opt-out of marketing emails regarding online surveys that pay well.

7. Contact Us

If you have questions about your privacy while using our online survey jobs work from home platform, contact us at privacy@surveypesa.co.ke.
